From: Jane Rossi <jane.rossi@finforward.com>

Subject: Quick 15-min demo after Wednesday webinar

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the session earlier — it was helpful. I signed up for the self-serve tier to kick the tires, and our product team would like a brief 15-minute walkthrough to understand how Redwood would fit into our ingestion pipeline and what the path to a dedicated deployment looks like.

Two quick questions up front: do you have a standard doc about PII handling/data retention we can share with security? And does Redwood support AWS PrivateLink for private deployments?

We'd prefer a short, focused call — just enough to confirm fit. Available windows for me (Pacific): 6/8 9:30–10:15, 6/8 14:00–15:00, or 6/9 morning.

Thanks,
Jane Rossi
Director of Product
FinForward

Hi Jane — great to meet you (virtually) and glad the webinar was useful. Happy to set up a 15-minute quickstart to walk through integration options and the path from self-serve to Dedicated/Private.

I can do 6/8 at 9:30 PT. If that works, I can send a calendar invite. If you'd like, we can have the session focus on either: (a) integration & SDK flow, or (b) deployment/compliance path — let me know which you prefer.

Quick answers: we have a security pack (SOC2 summary + data handling FAQ) I can share prior to the call, and PrivateLink is supported in our Private offering (we'll share architecture notes on the call).

Booking link: https://cal.redwood.com/s/mateo/15

Attached: redwood-one-pager.pdf (one-page overview), calendar stub if you want it.

Best,
